name: Mississippi Mud
description: Mississippi Mud: 7-card stud variant where the first and fourth upcards dealt to each player are wild for that player. Same deal as 7-card stud; two designated upcards act as wilds. USA; dealer's choice.

overview.description: Mississippi Mud: 7-card stud variant where the first and fourth upcards dealt to each player are wild for that player. Same deal as 7-card stud; two designated upcards act as wilds. USA; dealer's choice.

history.origins: American 7-card stud variant; named for the wild upcards. Distinct from the casino game Mississippi Stud.
timeline: Present: Played in wild-card and mixed games

setup.players: Two to eight players may take part; a standard 52-card pack is used. The game is best for five to seven players. When eight play, the deck may run out toward the end of the deal.
setup.dealing: Same as 7-card stud. First upcard (3rd street) and fourth upcard (6th street) for each player are wild for that player.

rules.objective: Make the best five-card poker hand from seven cards; your first and fourth upcards are wild for you.
rules.gameplay: Betting as in 7-card stud. At showdown, each player's 1st and 4th upcards are wild for that player; use any five of seven for best hand.
keyRules: First upcard (3rd street) and fourth upcard (6th street) are wild for that player
Not the same as the casino game Mississippi Stud

strategy.basic: Value strong non-wild hands when your upcard wilds don't help; chase big hands when wilds connect.
strategy.intermediate: Read opponents' wild cards; two wilds per player create strong hands frequently.

variations.emptyOverridesReason: No documented rule variations; add when sources provide variant overrides.
